statement: TechCrunch frames the Akamai-Anthropic deal as a bet on CPU-based distributed infrastructure for AI inference rather than on GPU training capacity.
why: If a large share of inference work can be served on distributed CPU infrastructure, some compute spend routes around merchant GPUs entirely.

impact.mechanism: Committing a multi-billion inference workload to CPU and CDN-style distributed capacity substitutes non-GPU compute for accelerator capacity at the margin.

evidence.excerpt: a bet on a less-hyped corner of AI infrastructure: CPUs

confidence.basis: Secondary reporting characterizing the deal; the document gives no split of workloads between CPU and GPU.
